For the curious seeker. You're exploring Jesus for the first time or coming back after a long time.

You will

  • Think
  • Read the short eyewitness story connected to the memory verse
  • Talk to God
  • Reflect
  • Remember one Bible verse
  • Respond in a simple, surprising way

For the serious seeker or growing believer. You want to understand Jesus more deeply and explore faith with intention.

You will

  • Think
  • Read a larger section of Mark — you'll finish the whole book in 31 days
  • Unpack the story with helpful questions
  • Talk to God
  • Remember a Bible verse
  • Journal
  • Respond in a meaningful way

For the embodied learner. You want to meditate on Scripture in a new way — through movement, breath, and fitness.

You will

  • Warm up your body and mind
  • Think
  • Read a short Bible segment
  • Do a WOD (Workout of the Day) that explores the theme
  • Remember a Bible verse
  • Rest
  • Stretch
  • Talk to God

    GO DEEPER · DAY 1 OF 31
    Day 1

    Jesus
    Foretold

    ReadMark 1:1–13
    Memory verseMark 1:7

    Mark begins by introducing John the Baptist, a prophet preparing people for Jesus' arrival. John knows Jesus is far greater than he is, and he wants everyone to be ready for Him.

    2. Read the Bible

    John the Baptist Prepares the Way1The beginning of the Good News of Jesus Christ, the Son of God. 2As it is written in the prophets, "Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you: 3the voice of one crying in the wilderness, 'Make ready the way of the Lord! Make his paths straight!'" 4John came baptizing in the wilderness and preaching the baptism of repentance for forgiveness of sins. 5All the country of Judea and all those of Jerusalem went out to him. They were baptized by him in the Jordan river, confessing their sins. 6John was clothed with camel's hair and a leather belt around his waist. He ate locusts and wild honey. 7He preached, saying, "After me comes he who is mightier than I, the thong of whose sandals I am not worthy to stoop down and loosen. 8I baptized you in water, but he will baptize you in the Holy Spirit."Jesus Is Baptised and Tested9In those days, Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized by John in the Jordan. 10Immediately coming up from the water, he saw the heavens parting, and the Spirit descending on him like a dove. 11A voice came out of the sky, "You are my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased."12Immediately the Spirit drove him out into the wilderness. 13He was there in the wilderness forty days, tempted by Satan. He was with the wild animals, and the angels were serving him.

    Demo version of this reading – not the actual Contemporary English Version (CEV) from the American Bible Society.

    1. Think

    Where do I underestimate Jesus?

    3. Study

    Click on a question to journal your thoughts.

    4. Walk & Talk With God

    Repeat "Jesus, show me who You are."
    Ask "Where do I need to see Your greatness?"
    Say "Jesus, I'm ready."

    5. Remember

    Today's key verse

    Tap the verse — read it 3 times, emphasising a different word each time.

    6. Respond

    Tap Spin to get a response, or make up your own.

    Write a short prayer beginning with "Show me Your greatness…"

    Before You Go

    "Jesus, help me notice You stepping toward me."
